notice: Research only; the published alpha.4 application is unchanged. Fixed waveform guard evaluated on synthetic positives, repeated-note counterexamples, and existing human-chart comparisons. Not a player-quality benchmark.

protocol.purpose: Can waveform evidence reject false connections without losing the sustained chord improvement?
protocol.limitation: A pitch band can contain multiple instruments or harmonics; absence of a dip does not establish one continuous musical event.

source_fingerprint_note: The archived source fingerprint differs only in LF/CRLF for manialab/server.py and manialab/planner.py after Git checkout. Every tracked analysis source hash was checked, permitting only equivalent whole-file LF/CRLF variants. No program semantics changed.

first_negative_false_holds.note: Includes pre-existing Basic Pitch long-interval errors; extension count alone is not total error count.

extended_negative_controls.description:
Additional fixed synthetic counterexamples for the waveform continuity guard.

Each repeated chord has an explicit 10/30/80ms silence in its own signal.
The overlapping distractor does not share its fundamental pitches. Parameters
are fixed before evaluation; these examples are not used to tune the guard.

decision: Do not enable. Short 10ms gaps still merge in two low-register controls, and real-reference endpoint improvement is too small/inconsistent. No thresholds revised after seeing these results.
